== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The Dark remaster specifies Bespin: Cloud City for the same generation bonus. It removes the placement-triggered 1-Force loss and uses the new-arrival loss rule for occupancy. The capture alternative under a Cloud City bounty hunter appears on both 2004 slips and the remaster.
